layers.name: Travel Time to Nearest Charger
layers.citation: Village-level car travel time to nearest public charger (r5r on OSM, max 60 min; origins GADM 4.1 villages, TTM by Alyas Widita); chargers from PLN Charge.IN Jun 2026 (1556 sites). ttm/compute.py

layers.name: Chargers within 10 min
layers.citation: Village-level car travel time to nearest public charger (r5r on OSM, max 60 min; origins GADM 4.1 villages, TTM by Alyas Widita); chargers from PLN Charge.IN Jun 2026 (1556 sites). ttm/compute.py

layers.name: Charger Access Class
layers.citation: Village-level car travel time to nearest public charger (r5r on OSM, max 60 min; origins GADM 4.1 villages, TTM by Alyas Widita); chargers from PLN Charge.IN Jun 2026 (1556 sites). ttm/compute.py

layers.name: Charging Capacity per Household
layers.citation: E2SFCA: charger kW reachable within 10 min per household (3.6 persons, Kontur 2023); sufficiency threshold 0.03 kW/household

layers.name: Charging Service Ladder
layers.citation: Service ladder: rung 0 = no charger within 10 min; rung 1 = reachable but < 0.03 kW/household; rung 2 = reachable and sufficient

layers.citation: Rebana metropolitan kecamatan (190): BPS Profil Kab/Kota 2024, PLN UID Jabar substation loading, charger register; analysis/rebana_build.py

layers.citation: Rebana metropolitan kecamatan (190): BPS Profil Kab/Kota 2024, PLN UID Jabar substation loading, charger register; analysis/rebana_build.py

layers.citation: Rebana metropolitan kecamatan (190): BPS Profil Kab/Kota 2024, PLN UID Jabar substation loading, charger register; analysis/rebana_build.py

layers.citation: Rebana metropolitan kecamatan (190): BPS Profil Kab/Kota 2024, PLN UID Jabar substation loading, charger register; analysis/rebana_build.py

layers.citation: Rebana metropolitan kecamatan (190): BPS Profil Kab/Kota 2024, PLN UID Jabar substation loading, charger register; analysis/rebana_build.py

layers.name: Substation Capacity
layers.citation: Jamali grid: substations and transmission lines from RUPTL 2025-2034 tables matched to OpenStreetMap (qastill/electraskillacademy); loading from PLN UID Jabar peak reports

layers.name: Substation Peak Loading
layers.citation: Jamali grid: substations and transmission lines from RUPTL 2025-2034 tables matched to OpenStreetMap (qastill/electraskillacademy); loading from PLN UID Jabar peak reports

layers.name: Power Plant Capacity
layers.citation: Jamali grid: substations and transmission lines from RUPTL 2025-2034 tables matched to OpenStreetMap (qastill/electraskillacademy); loading from PLN UID Jabar peak reports

layers.name: Transmission Lines
layers.citation: Jamali grid: substations and transmission lines from RUPTL 2025-2034 tables matched to OpenStreetMap (qastill/electraskillacademy); loading from PLN UID Jabar peak reports

layers.name: Charger Siting Priority
layers.citation: Siting priority 0-100 per Rebana kecamatan = 0.5 x need (mean of normalised population-weighted travel time to nearest charger and distance to charger) + 0.25 x demand (normalised log population) + 0.25 x grid readiness (normalised substation headroom). Inputs: analysis/rebana_data.json (rk)

layers.name: Rebana KPI Kecamatan
layers.citation: Kecamatan hosting designated Rebana industrial zones (KPI) and the four priority zones; analysis/rebana_data.json (rk.kpi, rk.priority)

layers.name: Population Beyond 30 min
layers.citation: Access gap: residents (Kontur 2023) of villages whose nearest public charger is more than 30 min by car or unreachable within 60 min; NoData = village within 30 min. ttm/ttm.json

layers.name: Coverage Model Picks
layers.citation: Greedy 10-km coverage model: the next kecamatan centroids that add the most Rebana residents within 10 km of a charger (baseline share 67%); value = residents newly covered. analysis/rebana_build.py

layers.name: Transformer Overload Share
layers.citation: Share of measured distribution transformers loaded above 100% per H3 res-7 hexagon (~5 km2), PLN UP3 Indramayu register (1638 transformers); aggregated, no transformer identities

layers.name: Solar PV Yield
layers.citation: Global Solar Atlas 2.0 (Solargis, World Bank/ESMAP), long-term annual average sampled every 0.025 deg via the GSA point API; data/open/prep.py. PVOUT: specific photovoltaic power output of a fixed, optimally tilted crystalline-silicon system

layers.name: Global Horizontal Irradiation
layers.citation: Global Solar Atlas 2.0 (Solargis, World Bank/ESMAP), long-term annual average sampled every 0.025 deg via the GSA point API; data/open/prep.py. GHI

layers.name: Direct Normal Irradiation
layers.citation: Global Solar Atlas 2.0 (Solargis, World Bank/ESMAP), long-term annual average sampled every 0.025 deg via the GSA point API; data/open/prep.py. DNI (relevant for CSP/tracking)

layers.name: Solar Seasonality
layers.citation: Global Solar Atlas 2.0 (Solargis, World Bank/ESMAP), long-term annual average sampled every 0.025 deg via the GSA point API; data/open/prep.py. Ratio of the lowest to the highest monthly PV output (100 = flat profile, lower = stronger wet-season dip)

layers.name: Air Temperature
layers.citation: Global Solar Atlas 2.0 (Solargis, World Bank/ESMAP), long-term annual average sampled every 0.025 deg via the GSA point API; data/open/prep.py. Mean annual air temperature at 2 m (PV output falls ~0.4%/degC above 25 degC)

layers.name: Wind Speed 100 m
layers.citation: Global Wind Atlas 3.0 (DTU Wind Energy / World Bank), mean wind speed at 100 m height, 250 m resolution

layers.name: Elevation
layers.citation: Global Solar Atlas 2.0 (Solargis, World Bank/ESMAP), long-term annual average sampled every 0.025 deg via the GSA point API; data/open/prep.py. Terrain elevation (ELE)

layers.name: Cropland Share
layers.citation: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (10 m Sentinel-1/2 land cover), aggregated to share of each cell; data/open/prep.py. Class 40 cropland

layers.name: Tree Cover Share
layers.citation: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (10 m Sentinel-1/2 land cover), aggregated to share of each cell; data/open/prep.py. Class 10 tree cover

layers.name: Built-up Share 2021
layers.citation: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (10 m Sentinel-1/2 land cover), aggregated to share of each cell; data/open/prep.py. Class 50 built-up

layers.name: Dominant Land Cover
layers.citation: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (10 m Sentinel-1/2 land cover), aggregated to share of each cell; data/open/prep.py. Most frequent class in the cell

layers.name: Built-up 2020 (GHSL)
layers.citation: GHSL R2023A (JRC): GHS-BUILT-S built-up surface (3 arcsec) and GHS-POP residents (3 arcsec); data/open/prep.py. Share of cell surface built in 2020

layers.name: Built-up Growth 2000-2020
layers.citation: GHSL R2023A (JRC): GHS-BUILT-S built-up surface (3 arcsec) and GHS-POP residents (3 arcsec); data/open/prep.py. Percentage-point increase of built-up share between 2000 and 2020 (cells with > 0.5 pp)

layers.name: Built-up Growth 1975-2000
layers.citation: GHSL R2023A (JRC): GHS-BUILT-S built-up surface (3 arcsec) and GHS-POP residents (3 arcsec); data/open/prep.py. Percentage-point increase of built-up share between 1975 and 2000

layers.name: Population 2025 (GHSL)
layers.citation: GHSL R2023A (JRC): GHS-BUILT-S built-up surface (3 arcsec) and GHS-POP residents (3 arcsec); data/open/prep.py. Residents 2025 per cell, expressed as density

layers.name: Population Change 2025-2030
layers.citation: GHSL R2023A (JRC): GHS-BUILT-S built-up surface (3 arcsec) and GHS-POP residents (3 arcsec); data/open/prep.py. Projected change of residents 2025 -> 2030 (cells with > 50 residents)

layers.name: Population Change 2000-2025
layers.citation: GHSL R2023A (JRC): GHS-BUILT-S built-up surface (3 arcsec) and GHS-POP residents (3 arcsec); data/open/prep.py. Change of residents 2000 -> 2025 (cells with > 50 residents in 2000)

layers.name: Flood Depth RP100
layers.citation: JRC Global Flood Hazard Maps (CEMS-GloFAS, Dottori et al.), river flood depth for a 100-year return period, 30 arcsec; data/open/prep.py. Maximum depth in the cell; NoData = not flooded

layers.name: Flood Hazard Class
layers.citation: JRC Global Flood Hazard Maps (CEMS-GloFAS, Dottori et al.), river flood depth for a 100-year return period, 30 arcsec; data/open/prep.py. Depth classes

layers.name: Rooftop PV Potential
layers.citation: Technical rooftop PV potential per cell = built-up area (WorldCover 2021) x 25% usable roof x 0.15 kWp/m2 x PVOUT (GSA). Indicative; no shading/structural screening

layers.name: Utility Solar Site Score
layers.citation: Screening score 0-100 for ground-mounted PV: 0.35 x PV yield + 0.30 x open land share (cropland/grass/bare, WorldCover) + 0.15 x flood-free (RP100 depth < 0.5 m) + 0.20 x proximity to a substation (< 15 km, Rebana kecamatan mean). Shown only where open land >= 50%, built-up < 20%, water < 10%, tree < 30%. Agricultural-land policy not screened

layers.name: Grid Assets in Flood Zone
layers.citation: Cells with a public charging station and/or a substation where the JRC 100-year river flood depth is >= 0.5 m

layers.name: Population in Flood Zone
layers.citation: Residents (GHSL 2025) living in cells with 100-year flood depth >= 0.5 m

layers.name: Growth Without Charging
layers.citation: Cells that gained > 2 pp of built-up surface 2000-2020 (GHSL) but whose village is still > 30 min by car from the nearest public charger (TTM): new settlement/industrial frontier without charging
